stem:
A capacitor *C* is charged so that the potential difference (p.d.) *V* across its terminals is 8.0 V. The capacitor is connected into the circuit of Fig. 6.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The switch is initially open. The switch is closed at time *t* = 0.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.lead:
Fig. 6.2 shows the variation of *V* with the charge *Q* on the plates of capacitor *C* as the capacitor discharges.

[[fig:f2]]
parts.text: Show that the energy stored in capacitor *C* at time *t* = 0 is 1.8 mJ.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the capacitance of capacitor *C*. Give a unit with your answer.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead:
Fig. 6.3 shows the variation with *t* of −ln($\frac{V}{8.0\ \mathrm{V}}$).

[[fig:f3]]
parts.text: Show that, when *t* is equal to one time constant, the value of −ln($\frac{V}{8.0\ \mathrm{V}}$) is equal to 1.0.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the time constant *τ* of the circuit in Fig. 6.1.

figures.caption: Fig. 6.1
figures.alt: A circuit diagram showing a capacitor C, a switch and a resistor R connected in a loop, with 8.0 V marked across the capacitor.

figures.caption: Fig. 6.2
figures.alt: A graph of voltage V against charge Q, with a straight line rising from the origin to approximately 8 V.

figures.caption: Fig. 6.3
figures.alt: A graph of −ln(V/8.0 V) against time t, with a straight line rising from the origin.
